name: List All Journal Entries
description: Returns all journal entries that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by journal entry unique identifier

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the property or association related to the journal entry

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter journal entries last updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Page size for pagination. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the journal entry

responseFields.name: data[].AccountingBasis
responseFields.description: The accounting basis for the journal entry.

responseFields.name: data[].EntryDate
responseFields.description: The date the journal entry was created. Valid format is "YYYY-MM-DD" e.g. "2022-03-03".

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the journal entry's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems[].Description
responseFields.description: A brief, informative description of the journal entry's line item

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems[].GlAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the general ledger account associated with the journal entry line item

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property or association related to the journal entry

responseFields.name: data[].ReferenceNumber
responseFields.description: The reference number representing the transaction in your ledger. This will be automatically assigned unless provided.

responseFields.name: data[].Remarks
responseFields.description: A description or summary of the journal entry

responseFields.name: data[].ScheduledReversalDate
responseFields.description: The date on which this journal entry is scheduled to be automatically reversed.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
